messages:
jamie: heads up — CI red on PR #8423: job `integration-e2e` failing in ephemeral-42. lots of `ECONNREFUSED` to testdb:5432.
ci-bot: Job integ-e2e failed (exit 1). Top error: `could not connect to host testdb:5432: Connection refused`. <https://ci.internal/runs/8423|details>
sree: assigning to infra. @infra-team can someone check mock-postgres in ephemeral-42? might be container crash or pvc issue.
infra-bot: Observability alert: mock-postgres-ephemeral-42 restarted 3 times in the last 2m. Image: redwood/mock-postgres:staging-202602. Recommended checks: `kubectl describe pod` + `kubectl logs`.
marta: on it, grabbing logs now. quick question — anyone changed init SQL or perms in the last deploy? could be migration failure.
marta: logs excerpt:
```
2026-03-17T10:12:34 startup: could not create extension pg_stat_statements: permission denied
FATAL: database files are incompatible
```
looks like startup error, maybe disk mount or incompatible data dir.
lee: iirc we had a PVC binding bug last week that caused old data to be mounted. @sree can you try forcing a pod reschedule to another node? `kubectl delete pod mock-postgres-ephemeral-42 -n ci-tests` will trigger new scheduling.
sree: doing delete now, also forcing ephemeral pvc recreation if needed. will post back when new pod healthy.
jamie: :thumbsup: once it's back i'll retrigger the CI rerun. also please hold merging — @alex (author) hold off on merge until we confirm.
alex: got it — holding merge. can't reproduce locally. point me to failing test if you want me to bisect.
marta: failing test name is `test_user_session_retry` but the trace shows db connection refused before tests start.
sree: new pod scheduled on infra-07, health checks passing. starting CI rerun: `ci rerun 8423`
ci-bot: Rerun queued: <https://ci.internal/runs/8423?attempt=2|run2>
jamie: thanks all. if rerun passes we'll label this an infra flake and file a short incident note. if it fails again we'll escalate to platform SRE.
lee: i'll follow up on PVC reclaim policy and node affinity to avoid recurrence. moving to postmortem channel for root-cause later.
